title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 78
paragraphs: So the Athenians grew in power. And it is clear, not from a single case but from every angle, that Equality is an excellent thing: for while the Athenians were ruled by tyrants, they were no better in war than any of those who lived around them, but once they had got rid of tyrants they became by far the first. This proves that when they were held down they were willfully slack, because they were working for a master; whereas, once they had been set free, each one was eager to achieve something for himself.
